title: AWS Pricing Calculator: estimate before you build

kcs.statement: AWS Pricing Calculator estimates the monthly cost of an architecture before anything is deployed; it is free, needs no AWS account and can export or share the estimate.
Pricing Calculator models planned costs and compares options such as On-Demand versus a Savings Plan, but it cannot report what an account has actually spent.

problem_ideas: A consultant must quote a client's monthly AWS cost before the account exists: which tool?
An estimate shows 3 EC2 instances at $70/month each plus 1 TB of S3 at $23: predict the monthly total.
A manager asks 'how much did we spend last month?' and gets a Pricing Calculator link: what is wrong?
Use the calculator to compare On-Demand with a 1-year Savings Plan for the same instance: what output tells you the saving?
A sales engineer needs to send an estimate to a CFO: which calculator feature?
Spot the false statement: 'Pricing Calculator requires an AWS account and billing access.'
